purpose: Verify widened PyPI discovery prioritizes the requested BSON format rather than generic action words.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,pathlib,json
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/capability_discovery.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cd',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
goal='Encode those exact records as BSON and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_RECORDS.bson'
out=m.search_pypi_packages(goal,limit=30,timeout_s=20)
names=[str(x.get('name') or '') for x in out.get('candidates') or []]
print(json.dumps({'queries':out.get('queries'),'names':names},sort_keys=True))
assert any('bson' in n.lower() for n in names),names
assert not any('encoder' in n.lower() and 'bson' not in n.lower() for n in names[:10]),names[:10]
print('PYPI_BSON_FORMAT_FIRST_DISCOVERY_VERIFIED')
PY
